verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document a built-in AI assistant in Windows that users can delegate tasks to. The Copilot mention covers Microsoft apps like Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, which are separate products. The other AI items are a single generative feature (Paint Cocreator), developer APIs (Windows AI APIs, AI Foundry toolkit), or a vague 'AI tools on Windows' heading. None of these show an in-product assistant that takes delegated tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
